notes: IEEE 1516.1-2025 public-API ownership scenario: an owner receives one tagged Request Divestiture Confirmation following a requester's acquisition and negotiated divestiture, invokes Confirm Divestiture inside that callback, and the requester receives one tagged acquisition notification with ownership transfer. Direct pinned native mappings are page-154-l156-49 -> §7.2, page-156-l41-12 -> §7.3.4, page-159-l53-11 -> §7.6.3, and page-161-l137-40 -> §7.8. Callback re-entry itself is supplemental public-API evidence; process endpoint and pushed receive-order transport are excluded. Adapter supplies provider, endpoint, FOM, names, callback model and logical-time implementation. Current-source installed-package C++ primary/contract passed 4/4 under evoked/immediate callbacks. Java parity compiles against the official API-only JAR but has no provider-runtime execution evidence. This is not a conformance claim.
